decisions.reason: The firm has invested in its laser marking line and the workstation fits its announced laser direction, so despite only modest website visibility it is likely kept as part of the portfolio.
High-resolution thermal inkjet is core to the REA JET coding business and has been presented on its own page for two years, signalling sustained commitment.
The piezo inkjet printer has its own dedicated page and sits at the center of the firm's high-resolution printing strategy, so sunk development and visible commitment favor keeping it.
Featuring the industrial laser marking systems on the home page is a strong public commitment to a strategic direction, which management will defend.
The LC400 cabin was announced publicly as new in 2024 and complements the laser line, so any early weakness would be attributed to its launch phase.
The Blechexpo award gives public validation that management can point to, which justifies continued investment in this niche application.
